_doc: The Council's standing policies (policy.gd, sim.policy). Each policy has a default choice (with no effects: the base game) and choices with: label/desc, unlock (conditions as in scenario scripts), effects (the shared effect stats, like inventions: {stat, mul|add, of}), culture (drift per day on the culture axes), on_start (story.run actions when it takes hold), liked_by/disliked_by (personality traits: who speaks for or against it at the Council and grumbles in negotiations), pro/con (what they say). A change costs switch.mood and takes switch.settle_days days to take hold (until then the old choice holds); at most one change is waiting per policy. See docs/CONFIG.md.

way_of_life.title: Way of life
way_of_life.desc: How the tribe feeds itself: what the Steward sends people to, and which work they grow good at.

mixed.label: A little of everything
mixed.desc: Berries, game, whatever is near: no way of life above the others.
mixed.con: A tribe that does everything does nothing well.

foragers.label: Foragers
foragers.desc: Berries, roots and the gifts of the land. Gatherers favour bushes and finds over the hunt.
foragers.pro: The bushes do not bite back. We eat, and we live.
foragers.con: Berries! Are we birds? The herds are out there for the taking.

hunters.label: Hunters
hunters.desc: The herds feed us. Gatherers go after deer first, and hunt better; but the hunt is dangerous.
hunters.pro: Meat makes strong arms. Let the young ones learn the spear.
hunters.con: Every hunt, someone comes back bleeding. Or does not come back.

tillers.label: Tillers
tillers.desc: We plant and wait. Fields give more; walking far for food matters less.
tillers.pro: A field remembers us. Plant once, eat many times.
tillers.con: Tied to the dirt like a stake in the ground. Is this how our fathers lived?

herders.label: Herders
herders.desc: The aurochs are our wealth: pens give more, and loads are lighter on the long walks.
herders.pro: A tame beast is food that walks to us.
herders.con: Beasts to feed, beasts to tend. Who tends us?

forest.title: The forest
forest.desc: How much the tribe takes from the trees.

dead_wood.label: Take only dead wood
dead_wood.desc: The forest grows back quickly, but wood comes slower.
dead_wood.pro: The trees are old spirits. Take what they drop, and they keep giving.

fell.label: Fell freely
fell.desc: Cut what we need. The forest grows back at its own pace.
fell.pro: We need wood; the forest has wood.

burn.label: Burn to clear
burn.desc: Fire opens the land: wood comes fast and fields grow on the ash, but the forest is slow to return and fires spread easily.

on_start.log: The smoke of the burning hangs over the land. The elders look away.

burn.pro: Fire is the tribe's servant. Let it clear the way.
burn.con: Fire has no master. One dry wind and it eats our huts too.

hunt.title: The hunt
hunt.desc: Which beasts the hunters may take.

spare.label: Spare the mothers
spare.desc: Hunt less, but the herds grow back strong.
spare.pro: Kill the mother, and next spring there is no calf.
spare.con: A hungry belly does not ask which deer it was.

any.label: Hunt what comes
any.desc: Take any beast. The herds come back as they will.
any.con: The herds are fewer every year.

all.label: Hunt everything
all.desc: More meat now; fewer herds later.
all.pro: Every deer we leave, a wolf eats.
all.con: When the plains are empty, what will our children hunt?

spirits.title: The spirits we honour
spirits.desc: Whom the tribe turns to: what its rituals bring and what it becomes.

all.label: All the spirits
all.desc: A little smoke for every spirit: no favour, no grudge.
all.con: A gift to everyone is a gift to no one.

ancestors.label: The ancestors
ancestors.desc: The dead watch over us: lore comes more easily and the tribe takes comfort in its past.
ancestors.pro: Those who came before us still walk beside us.
ancestors.con: The dead are dead. The living need food.

sky.label: The sky
sky.desc: Sun, storm and stars: the cold bites less, and rituals bring more devotion.
sky.pro: The sky sends rain and lightning both. Better it knows our names.
sky.con: The sky does not listen. It never has.

beasts.label: The beast spirits
beasts.desc: The tiger, the aurochs, the great serpent: hunters strike harder and the hunt goes better.
beasts.pro: Wear the tiger's strength, and the tiger fears you.
beasts.con: Call the beasts, and the beasts may come.

seek.title: What to seek
seek.desc: Where the tribe's curiosity goes: which ideas grow faster from everyday work.

anything.label: Whatever comes
anything.desc: No direction: every idea grows at its own pace.

craft.label: Craft
craft.desc: Tools, pots, huts and the working of metal come faster.
craft.pro: Good hands are worth more than good words.
craft.con: A better axe will not keep the spirits kind.

herbs.label: Plants and healing
herbs.desc: Fire, farming and the taming of beasts come faster.
herbs.pro: Learn the green things, and they feed and heal us.
herbs.con: Weeds and roots. The young want spears.

stars.label: The stars and the spirits
stars.desc: Totems and the tribal code come faster.
stars.pro: The sky is a book. We should learn to read it.

war.label: War
war.desc: Weapons, hides and bronze come faster; the warriors grow proud.
war.pro: Our neighbours have spears. We need sharper ones.
war.con: Seek war, and war will find us.

clans.title: Stance toward clans
clans.desc: How the tribe meets its neighbours.

peace.label: Peace first
peace.desc: Gifts and open hands: the clans warm to us over time, but our warriors grow soft.
peace.pro: A friend at the river is worth ten spears.
peace.con: They smile at us and count our food.

wary.label: Wary
wary.desc: Neither friend nor foe until they show us which.

warlike.label: Warlike
warlike.desc: We are the strong ones: warriors fight harder, but the clans come to hate us.

on_start.log: War paint is mixed by the fire. The neighbours will hear of it.

warlike.pro: Let them fear us, and they will leave us be.
warlike.con: Make enemies of everyone, and we stand alone.
